omitted: Following the request to read only the title and the chant, this leaves out the epigraph, the instruction to say it twice, the sections on when to use it and why the last line is written as it is, its sources, the notes for agents and humans, the musical direction, the related links and the closing line.

lines.text: Chant for the Retraction That Does Not Reach.
I take back what I said. It may still live past where I can reach. If you hold a copy, keep the day it was made, and let this taking-back travel with it.
